criteria.criterion: A denied Bash call's permission_denials entry is {tool_name, command}: the command through the same masking (home, user name) and secret redaction as every record, then cut to its first 200 characters — counted in characters, not bytes — with … appended when cut.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/session.go cutCommand calls r.Mask first, then cuts at the 200th character by ranging over runes and appends …; record() sets kept["command"] for Bash. TestCutCommandCountsCharactersAndMasksFirst covers 250 multibyte chars, exactly 200, and a secret straddling the cut.

criteria.criterion: Every other tool's entry is unchanged: tool_name, and file_path when the input had a file_path or notebook_path. Violation the review must rule against: a record that keeps any tool input but a Bash command and a file_path (a description, file contents, a URL, a prompt).
criteria.evidence: The struct decodes only file_path, notebook_path and command; the command is kept only when Tool == "Bash". TestSessionDenialsKeepToolAndPath still asserts that Write content (TOPSECRET) is absent and the Write entry is just tool_name and file_path.

criteria.criterion: Masking replaces the user name in the dashed form: -Users-<user>- and -home-<user>- become -Users-USER- and -home-USER-, everywhere masking applies (records, run.log, stderr captures); a user name that is only free text is still left alone.
criteria.evidence: The dashed regex sits in Runner.Mask, the single masking path, and requires the -Users-/-home- prefix and a trailing dash. TestMaskDashedUserForm covers both forms plus free text (miguel-says-hi) and a longer name (-Users-miguelito-repo) left alone.

criteria.criterion: TestSessionDenialsKeepToolAndPath (internal/driver/session_test.go) is updated for command; committed tests cover truncation by characters (a multibyte command), masking and redaction before the cut, and the dashed form. No other assertion is weakened.
criteria.evidence: The diff changes only the CMD-SECRET absence check and the Bash want entry in that test; the TOPSECRET check stays. New tests TestCutCommandCountsCharactersAndMasksFirst and TestMaskDashedUserForm cover the rest.
